title: AIOS Checkpoint Index
description: Schema for the AIOS central checkpoint index

lastUpdated.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the last index update

activeCheckpoints.description: Active checkpoints — projects in progress or paused

slug.description: Project slug used as filename (kebab-case, only a-z 0-9 and hyphen)

savedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the checkpoint was saved

lastActiveAgent.description: Last active agent recorded in the checkpoint

nextActionSummary.description: One-line summary of the next action — for dashboard display and multi-project listings

archivedCheckpoints.description: Archived checkpoints — completed or discarded projects

savedAt.description: Timestamp of when the checkpoint was last saved before archiving

archivedAt.description: Timestamp of when the checkpoint was archived

archiveReason.description: Reason for archiving: completed = user confirmed completion, auto_detected_completion = all tasks are done in activity-log, user_discarded = user discarded explicitly
